## Activity

During December 2021, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 356 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and reflects the imaging work completed by the clinic team. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. There were no other operational issues identified in the information provided for this report.

## Image quality

Of the 356 captures, 28 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.9. These images could not be used for grading, and the result is reported separately from the total number of captures to support monitoring of image quality. The rate should be considered alongside the overall activity recorded during December 2021.

## Grading

Grading identified 77 referable results. The median lag from capture to completed grading was 17 days. This measure summarises the time taken for the central grading process during the reporting period. Together, the grading outcome and the median lag provide a concise view of referral activity and turnaround at West Gate Eye Clinic.
